name: std::atomic_flag_test_and_set, std::atomic_flag_test_and_set_explicit
intro:
Atomically changes the state of a std::atomic_flag pointed to by obj to set (true) and returns the value it held before.

1,2) The memory synchronization order is std::memory_order_seq_cst.

3,4) The memory synchronization order is order.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
obj

 -

 pointer to std::atomic_flag to access


 order

 -

 the memory synchronization order

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The value previously held by the flag pointed to by obj.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: std::atomic_flag_test_and_set and std::atomic_flag_test_and_set_explicit can be implemented as obj->test_and_set() and obj->test_and_set(order) respectively.
